heading.title: Trial before a Court of Session

article.title: Conviction on plea of guilty
article.content: If the accused pleads guilty, the Judge shall record the plea and may, in his discretion, convict him thereon.
article.html:
252Conviction on plea of guilty

Section 252 · Chapter XIX

If the accused pleads guilty, the Judge shall record the plea and may, in his discretion, convict him thereon.
